caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design with a central dragon-like creature in a stylized, geometric form. The creature is predominantly red with accents of yellow, white, gray, and black outlines, and it has a prominent eye and an open mouth with visible teeth. The dragon's wings are yellow with black lines, and its body curves vertically in the center of the textile panel. The background of the central area is a light beige or tan color with subtle, wavy decorated patterns and evenly spaced circular motifs in pale purple-gray. Flanking the central creature, on both the left and right sides, are narrow vertical borders with repeated diamond shapes and stylized floral patterns in yellow/gold and pink/red, on a similar tan background. The vertical borders are outlined in black and red stripes. The textile design appears to be a fragment, with one edge unfinished and threads visible, and faint sketch lines for the design are visible on the right side of the drawing.
title: Woven Textile: Technique Demonstration
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
